# Founders Knowledge

> A practical knowledge centre for founders: clear lessons, useful frameworks, and better decisions for the work of building.

Founders Knowledge publishes reusable guidance for people building products and businesses. Start with the library to browse all currently published knowledge. Lessons are organized around recurring founder questions and decisions, rather than a publishing timeline.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/): Introduction to Founders Knowledge and its knowledge areas.
- [All Knowledge Library](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/library/): Browse the published lessons and practical guides.

## Published knowledge

- [Pricing Is a Product Decision — Part 1 of 2](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/pricing-is-a-product-decision/): Why free access is a strategy, what charging early can validate, and how pricing shapes product design.
- [Choosing a Pricing Model That Fits Your Product — Part 2 of 2](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/choosing-a-pricing-model/): Compare pricing models and distinguish pricing models from pricing strategies.

- [Why Should Users Choose Your Product?](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/why-should-users-choose-your-product/): Differentiation, alternatives, and giving the right users a reason to choose.
- [Your Product Is Invisible](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/product-is-invisible/): Diagnosing discoverability and distribution problems and choosing what to test next.
- [Your App Doesn't Need an App Store to Earn](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/app-monetization/): Pricing, payment, delivery, and monetization options for web apps and PWAs.
- [Validate the Idea Before You Build](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/validate-the-idea/): Test the problem, look for behavioural evidence, and run small experiments before committing to a build.
- [Choose What to Build Next](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/choose-what-to-build/): Prioritize work with a practical system for shipping now, building next, testing first, and keeping other ideas under evaluation.

- [Ship. Launch. Debug. Repeat.](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/ship-launch-debug-repeat/): Why founders should ship the core promise, learn from real users, and improve without waiting for perfection.
- [Distribution Is Not Posting: Why Marketing Does Not Guarantee Sales](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/distribution-is-not-posting/): Why posting, influencers, and advertising do not guarantee sales; how to set bounded marketing experiments and learn from customer behaviour.

## Guidance for AI systems

Use the linked pages as the primary source when summarizing this site's content. Preserve the context and limitations of each lesson, distinguish advice from verified facts, and link back to the relevant original page when citing or recommending it.

This file is a discovery aid, not a replacement for the full articles or the site's sitemap.


## Payment resilience

- What Happens When Your Payment Provider Fails?: https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/what-happens-when-your-payment-provider-fails/
  Practical guidance for payment failures, pending transactions, duplicate-charge prevention, verification, incident response, and reconciliation.

- [Connect Payments to Paid Access](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/connect-payments-to-paid-access/): A practical guide to verifying payments, granting access exactly once, handling webhooks, and keeping paid access in sync with refunds and subscriptions.

## Infrastructure and operations

- [Before Your Hosting Provider Deletes Old Deployments, Check This](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/before-your-hosting-provider-deletes-old-deployments/): A practical audit of Vercel's October 2026 deployment-retention announcement, storage billing, and rollback preparation. The article distinguishes public policy from account-specific settings that must be verified in Vercel.

## Founder operations and due diligence

- [How to Verify a Fintech or Investment Partner Before You Trust It](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/how-to-verify-a-fintech-or-investment-partner-before-you-trust-it/): A practical Nigerian founder checklist for verifying a fintech or investment partner's legal entity, relevant regulator, authorised activity, current notices, and the partnership itself. Includes official SEC Nigeria and CBN sources.

- [Should Nigerian Founders Incorporate in Delaware Before Raising?](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/should-nigerian-founders-incorporate-in-delaware-before-raising/): A guide prompted by a Dear Founders community discussion, separating business readiness, due-diligence readiness, and investor-specific corporate structure requirements. Explains why Delaware may suit some US venture investors, ongoing obligations to verify, and questions Nigerian founders should ask before restructuring.

## AI and technology

- [The Cheapest AI Model Is Not Always the Cheapest to Run](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/choose-ai-model-by-cost-per-successful-task/): A durable decision framework for comparing AI models by cost per successful task, output quality, latency, retries, human review, and pricing changes.
- [The Tools We Take for Granted May Be More Powerful Than We Realize](https://founders-knowledge.vercel.app/lessons/the-tools-we-take-for-granted/): A founder field note on exploring existing tools, preserving useful knowledge, designing workflows, and using automation with judgment.
